pages.title: A Clean Chimney
pages.text: Maintain smoky architecture; extra chimneys and chimes furnish a lively roofline.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Scrape soot with an axe for a possible Black Dye drop. Empty hand toggles smoke; redstone suppresses it. Stacking another section creates signal-style smoke.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Expose wood to fire or place surfaces by campfire smoke. Charred wood resists further burning and is not furnace fuel; ash piles accumulate, while soot is decorative.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Scrape accumulated soot off a chimney with an axe. Clean the chimney with a chance of obtaining Black Dye.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Right-click a chimney with an empty hand or apply a redstone signal. Toggle smoke manually, or suppress it with redstone power.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Stack one chimney above another. Emit the taller signal-smoke variant.
